tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /spros med rgyun gyi rnal 'byor gyi nyams len zab mo 'jam dbyangs ye shes 'char byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru mañdzu badz+ra ye/ bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /spros med rgyun gyi nyams len ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ rang nyid gnas pa'i sa phyogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra gur me 'od dang bcas pa'i nang du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rgyan rta babs thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma ma he gshin rje dang bcas pa'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs zhe sdang gshin rje gshed dbyer med pa/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dbyug pa dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang snyom par sbyor ba'i sku can du gyur/ de'i mtha' bskor du/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma sprin gyi phung po 'thib pa bzhin du bzhugs pa/ gzhan yang 'gro ba rigs drug gi bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad dang / khyad par nad bdag rims bdag gnod byed thams cad 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī rak+ta ya ma a ri maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ pa daṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ a lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi ti/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥru pa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥshap+ta badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥgan+da badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥr sa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥpar+ṣe badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi thugs ka nas rig ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa sprul nas phul bas/

zag med kyi bde ba la longs spyod par gyur/ bdag dang mchod rdzas/ mchod yul rnams spros med kyi ngang du bzhag dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol zhes pa lan gsum la sogs pas gsol ba btab/ thog mar dgra thams cad phul/ de nas gnyen thams cad phul/ phrag dog pa'i yul thams cad phul/ gang yang mi skye ba'i gti mug gi yul rnams kyang phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che nas bdag gi bsam pa mkhyen par mdzad du gsol/ bdag la thugs rjes bzung du gsol/ /bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ rang gi lag g.yas par shes rab kyi ral dri rno ngar dang ldan pa zhig byung ste/ smin mtshams nas bcad pa'i thod pa mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du bzhag dang por rkang pa g.yas pa/ de nas g.yon pa/ ros smad/ nang khrol thams cad/ mgo bo/ lag pa g.yon/ ro stod/ mthar lag pa g.yas pa ral gri dang bcas pa yang thod pa'i nang du skyur/ rang rlung sems las grub pa'i 'jam dbyangs kyi skur gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum brjod pas/ zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo kā pa la thogs pa dpag med sprul te/ thog mar phud/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ de nas brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma mkha' 'gro chos srung rnams la phul bas zag med kyi bde ba sku nyams su bltar bas/ bdag la mchog gi dngos grub bstsal bar bsam/ drin can gyi pha ma'i gtso byas/ rigs drug gnod byed/ gzhi bdag lan chags 'ded pa la phul bas/ zag med kyi bde ba rgyas pas rim gnyis kyi ting 'dzin bzang po rgyud la skyes te sangs rgyas pas lan chags khyer/ gnod sems thams cad zhi nas/ bdag gi 'gal rkyen thams cad sel zhing / mthun rkyen thams cad sgrub pa'i tshul gyi thugs dgyes te rang rang gi gnas su gshegs/

'das pa'i mgron rnams mtha' nas rim gyis bsdus te rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsam la/ ngag tu/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma'i thugs rang gi sems dbyer med du gyur pas/ sems kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ thugs rdo rje chos kyi skur gyur par bsam/ chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma'i gsung dang rang gi ngag dbyer med du gyur pas/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ rang gi ngag gsung rdo rje longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skur/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma'i sku dang / rang gi lus dbyer med du gyur pas/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ rang gi lus sku rdo rje sprul pa'i skur gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ de thams cad dbyer med pa ye shes rdo rje nyid kyi skur gyur/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rang la thim/ rang gi sems hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam pa de/ sna bug gam/ smin mtshams sam/ spyi gtsug nas thon te mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas pa'i zhabs kyu khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de na da la/ na da yang mi dmigs pa'i ngang la yun ring du mnyam par bzhag pas/ rnam rtog 'phros na/ rnam rtog 'od gsal gyi nyams len ni/ gang 'phros pa'i rnam rtog 'od dmar po mthe bong tsam zhig tu gyur te/ spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar la/ yar khyug mar khyug phar khyug tshur khyug byas nas rnam rtog thams cad bsdus nas snying dkar nag gi mtshams sam/ spyi gtsug nas bton te/ rgya mtsho'i mtha' ru bskyal/ lus las kyi rlung gis bskyod de bde ba can du sleb pa de/

o āḥhūm̐ gis byin rlabs te/ 'od dpag med 'khor bcas mchod/ sems 'od la gtad pas nam mkha'i mtha' khyab la yal te song ba'i ngang la bzhag ste/ rang gi sems rnam par rtog pa nam mkha' stong pa dang bzhi/ dbyer med pa spros med kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /rnam rtog skyes pa dang / rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs nas thim pas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag nyid/ bla ma dam pas bdag la byin gyis brlabs du gsol/ mos pa rtse gcig pas gsol ba mang du btab ste/ bla ma 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thims pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dang / bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dbyer med kyi ngang la bzhag skye ba kun du sogs brjod/ rnam rtog 'od gsal dang / bla ma'i rnal 'byor cig rgyun gyi nyams len dang gsum/ byin rlabs kyi rgyun ma chad par 'chag med kyi gtso bo yin pas 'dir bkod pa yin/ gzhan rnams kyang skabs dang sbyar nas nyams su blang dgos pa yin no/ /zhes pa 'di yang mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i gsung rgyun rje byams pa chos legs las brgyud de 'phags chen dpal ldan bkra shis la bab pa bzhin rje nyid kyi gsung rab las btus te dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis gdan sa chen por gshed dmar spros med kyi khrid lan gsum bshad pa'i phyi ma'i tshe rang dang chos nyan rnams kyi don du bzhi thog bla brang gi tshoms dmar du mgyogs par sbyar ba 'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o//
